annotations.name: Authorial Annotations
annotations.truth: A map can tell the generator what it is — not just what it contains. The @ codes are where the author speaks.
annotations.description: Reference sequence demonstrating the @-prefixed authorial annotations used by the map pipeline. Not pedagogy — tooling example. Each map focuses on one family of codes so you can read them in isolation before seeing them composed.
learning_objectives: Read the @-code vocabulary at a glance
See how size parameters (:W:D) render as footprints
See how keys (@sample:key) attach semantic handles
Understand the strength ladder: @void (forbid placement) → @hold (freeze region) → @sample (golden reference)
